summary: Validated expanded catalog, difficulty/section/search filters, authenticated bookmark persistence, imported FMS session start, and mobile overflow.
action_items: Load frontend/.env or configure REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before invoking pytest directly; the existing regression test otherwise builds an empty URL.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT_SECRET falls back to a short development secret and emits an insecure key-length warning; production configuration should require a sufficiently long secret.
seed_data_creation: Created one temporary TEST_ prefixed account and bookmark/session during browser testing; no seeded production data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catalog rendered 101 cases; Hard and Guesstimate filters, search interaction, bookmark add/reload persistence/remove, imported Coffee Capsule session start, and 390px no-overflow passed. Test credentials file is empty; temporary account was used.
rca of the issue: The unsourced pytest invocation failed before making an HTTP request because backend_test.py reads REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL only from process.env and does not parse frontend/.env. Sourcing frontend/.env made the same test pass. An unauthenticated bookmark click correctly opened the sign-in modal, so that initial browser assertion was an expected auth gate rather than an application defect.
